checks.name: lint
hints: Run `bunx biome check . --write` to auto-fix lint errors

checks.name: build
hints: Run `bun install` if this is a fresh checkout
Check for TypeScript errors in the files you modified

checks.name: tests
hints: Run `bun run test` to see detailed test output
Check if new code needs corresponding tests

checks.name: typecheck
checks.command: bunx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --target esnext lib/**/*.ts
hints: Check type definitions in the files you modified
Ensure all imports have proper type declarations
